src='''from collections import Counter
def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    thr=h*w*0.05
    rare={c for c,n in cnt.items() if n<thr}
    def nr(c): return sum(1 for r in range(h) if all(x==c or x in rare for x in g[r]))
    def nc(c): return sum(1 for c2 in range(w) if all(g[r][c2]==c or g[r][c2] in rare for r in range(h)))
    bg=max((c for c in cnt if c not in rare), key=lambda c: nr(c)+nc(c))
    fill=Counter(x for r in g for x in r if x!=bg).most_common(1)[0][0]
    marks={c for c in cnt if c not in (bg,fill)}
    hrows=[r for r in range(h) if all(x!=fill for x in g[r]) and any(x in marks for x in g[r])]
    vcols=[c for c in range(w) if all(g[r][c]!=fill for r in range(h)) and any(g[r][c] in marks for r in range(h))]
    res=[]
    for a,b in zip(hrows,hrows[1:]):
        row=[]
        for c1,c2 in zip(vcols,vcols[1:]):
            cs={g[a][c1],g[a][c2],g[b][c1],g[b][c2]}
            row.append(cs.pop() if len(cs)==1 and cs!={bg} else fill)
        res.append(row)
    return res
'''
